column1: # S-STORE-007 (U-17): participant pruning on a Canton 3.7.2 Community sandbox started with max-deduplication-duration = 10s.
# columns as tests/oracle/json-api/requests.tsv; two extra methods: CONSOLE (`prune <offset>` as the participant console runs it,
# the body is the offset) and SLEEP (the path is the number of seconds). An `exact` entry `/pointer=name` means: the value at the
# pointer must equal the offset bound as `name` in the same run (offsets differ between the node and this server).
# An `exact` entry `/pointer~A|B` is an answer the node gives differently as time passes (UNRESOLVED U-19): the recording and this server
# must each give one of the listed values. p17 is prune(ledger end) after the wait: OFFSET_OUT_OF_RANGE while the node's ledger end has
# not moved past the offset, UNSAFE_TO_PRUNE ("ACS digest ingestion") once it has; a prune that fails changes nothing, so the rest is unaffected.
